requirements.quote: 12 October 2026 / acknowledge participation by 16 October 2026
requirements.text: Bidder must acknowledge participation by 16 October 2026.

requirements.quote: 23 October 2026, 17:00 IST; cite section and requirement ID
requirements.text: Questions close on 23 October 2026 at 17:00 IST, citing section and requirement ID.

requirements.quote: 30 October 2026; issued to all registered bidders
requirements.text: Consolidated answers and final addendum issued by 30 October 2026.

requirements.quote: 13 November 2026, 17:00 IST; late offers may be rejected
requirements.text: Proposals must be received by 13 November 2026 at 17:00 IST; late offers may be rejected.

requirements.quote: 16-27 November 2026; demonstrations may be requested
requirements.text: Evaluation and clarification occur between 16-27 November 2026; demonstrations may be requested.

requirements.quote: 11 December 2026 / 14 December 2026 (subject to contract)
requirements.text: Intended award on 11 December 2026 and kickoff on 14 December 2026, subject to contract.

requirements.quote: Submit a searchable, signed technical PDF and a separately marked commercial PDF with its editable XLSX price workbook to the designated contact on page 1.
requirements.text: Submit a signed technical PDF and commercial PDF with editable XLSX price workbook.

requirements.quote: Use subject 2026-EMS-017 | Bidder legal name | Proposal.
requirements.text: Use specified subject format for submission emails.

requirements.quote: Maximum email size is 20 MB; request an upload route before closing if larger.
requirements.text: Email submissions must not exceed 20 MB; request upload route if larger.

requirements.quote: Receipt time at the buyer controls.
requirements.text: Buyer controls receipt time for submissions.

requirements.quote: Acknowledgement is not acceptance.
requirements.text: Acknowledgement of submission does not imply acceptance.

requirements.quote: Only the designated contact may issue procurement instructions.
requirements.text: Only the designated contact can issue procurement instructions.

requirements.quote: Questions and responses affecting scope will be circulated anonymously by numbered addendum.
requirements.text: Scope-related questions and responses will be circulated anonymously via numbered addendum.

requirements.quote: Oral statements are not binding.
requirements.text: Oral statements are not binding.

requirements.quote: Bidders shall acknowledge every addendum in Form A.
requirements.text: Bidders must acknowledge every addendum in Form A.

requirements.quote: Offers shall remain valid for 120 calendar days from closing.
requirements.text: Offers must remain valid for 120 days from closing.

requirements.quote: All bid preparation costs are borne by the bidder.
requirements.text: Bid preparation costs are the bidder's responsibility.

requirements.quote: Shall denotes a mandatory requirement. Should denotes a preference.
requirements.text: 'Shall' indicates mandatory requirements; 'should' indicates preferences.

requirements.quote: Requirements, tables and dimensioned figures are normative unless labelled illustrative.
requirements.text: Requirements, tables, and figures are normative unless marked illustrative.

requirements.quote: State each departure in Form B; silence is not an approved exception.
requirements.text: State departures in Form B; silence is not an exception.

requirements.quote: Buyer changes to requirements or dates will be made only by written addendum.
requirements.text: Buyer changes to requirements or dates are only via written addendum.

requirements.quote: The buyer may cancel, reject all offers or request a best and final offer without an obligation to award.
requirements.text: Buyer may cancel, reject offers, or request final offers without obligation to award.
